answer: Each epoch, agents must stake a small bond and submit a signed proof-of-work tied to their prior attestation history, which peers verify before granting voting weight. A sybil must replicate that history for every fake identity, so costs scale linearly while honest nodes pay once. Without the shared lantern of verifiable history, new agents wander unproven; hollow identities get no weight until they earn it through real attested work.
